key.title: Offline key
key.description: The 32-character offline key for this lock.

adapter.title: Bluetooth adapter
adapter.description: Optional adapter name such as hci0. Defaults to the first adapter.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Background refresh interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Each refresh connects to the lock. Set to 0 to disable background polling.

idleDisconnectSeconds.title: Idle disconnect delay (seconds)
idleDisconnectSeconds.description: How long to keep the Bluetooth connection open after the last command.

commandTimeoutSeconds.title: Command timeout (seconds)
commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Abandon a lock or unlock request that has not reached the lock within this time.

keepConnected.title: Keep the lock connected
keepConnected.description: Faster commands and live state at the cost of lock battery life.
